rows.label: qst103908_msg0001
rows.name:
Huh? Wha-wha-what?
How did you get back, mo?

rows.label: qst103908_msg0002
rows.name:
I thought the strong monsters might
stop you, or you'd end up as
Superbian soil...

rows.label: qst103908_msg0003
rows.name:
Waaah! Don't be angry, mo!
I'll tell the truth, mo!

rows.label: qst103908_msg0005
rows.name:
I charge just a tiiiny bit extra
in handling fees, so it was
hard to say...

rows.label: qst103908_msg0007
rows.name:
Being a courier in
Superbia is tough, mo!

rows.label: qst103908_msg0008
rows.name:
Slipping shiny things under soldiers'
armor, or bringing them gifts...

rows.label: qst103908_msg0009
rows.name:
To ease that stress, I sometimes go
to a hot spring... but only
very rarely, mo!

rows.label: qst103908_msg0010
rows.name:
A shipment of 82,166G comes
in... and 66,554G gets sent
to Liberalitas, mo.

rows.label: qst103908_msg0011
rows.name:
That's the honest truth, mo!
I don't take any more, mo.

rows.label: qst103908_msg0012
rows.name:
I don't know the shipping cost from
the port in Liberalitas to
Iyasaki Village, mo.

rows.label: qst103908_msg0013
rows.name:
If you go to Rijite Port in
Liberalitas, there's an old courier
named Schuchit.

rows.label: qst103908_msg0014
rows.name: You should ask him directly, mo.

rows.label: qst103908_msg0101
rows.name:
Just because Nopon are small,
they tell us to dock our big
ships at the tiny pier...mo...

rows.label: qst103908_msg0102
rows.name:
But they don't say that to
ships from the Avaritia Trading
Company... It's so unfair, mo!
